provenance: Frozen PP-OCRv6 Small FP32 baseline: exact text/stages and detector samples. Output preservation, not language-accuracy certification.

detector_maps.source: Independent FP32 Core ML CPU detector, evaluated on all 25 committed/generated regression inputs before removing that engine.
detector_maps.encoding: round(probability * 65535), uint16, flattened C order; maximum error 0.5/65535. Test data only: inference and model weights remain FP32.
